complete_examples.text: However, the discontinuity between adjacent track slabs for mitigating the thermal expansion effects was neglected.
In this paper, a more versatile VTIM is proposed by considering the discontinuity of track slabs, and a novel CCM is also developed to achieve the infinite length computations.
In this research, the elastoplasticity of track slabs is taken into consideration.
Certainly, the unrecoverable plastic deformation of track slabs can also be obtained.
CZMs have obtained intensive attention for the last two decades and have been employed in railway track filed to predict the interlaminar failure between track slabs and filling layers.
It should be noted the track slabs are treated as non-prestressed concrete slabs.

In the numerical examples, the errors of FEM-based and hierarchical function-based track structure models are analyzed from the perspective of characteristic frequency; the computational efficiency and accuracy of different hierarchical function-based coupled dynamics models of vehicle-track are compared; finally, the shear effect of rails and track slabs on the dynamic response of the system is analyzed.
